content.short: FractioNFT is a TON NFT tool for fractional ownership and trading around collectible assets.
content.description: FractioNFT is listed as a TON NFT tool for making ownership of digital collectibles easier to split and trade. The available project links point to a Telegram-connected NFT experience rather than a broad marketplace. This entry describes it conservatively as an NFT utility app for fractional access, collection activity, and TON-based ownership workflows. FractioNFT supports NFT activity around discovery, lending, analysis, valuation, or asset management instead of acting only as a marketplace.
